instruction: Cinematic full shot of a boxing gym. On the left, the East Asian woman in the white sports bra (R2) sits on the edge of the boxing ring wearing black leggings and beige sneakers, looking away to the left with black boxing gloves on. On the right, the woman in the black and orange athletic outfit (R1) stands on the floor in white sneakers, looking down as she wraps her hands with a long black hand wrap. Cool overhead lighting casts soft shadows across the gym floor.
